description:
Michael Jackson travels back to the past and befriends a boy named Mike who changes his life forever.

 Trapped between 2 worlds the past and the present as they both try to fixed each others lives that's often filled with a lot of pain, somehow they find joy and strength within each other, among all the chaos its them against the world, nothing or no one can come between. a true testament to me myself and I. A bond that only a few can understand. 2 famous superstars.

Mike a famous lead singer of the Jackson Five known as cute adorable, mature, intelligent outspoken and very wise for his age, face the difficulties of being the golden child and the heartache from his father who never was, a loss of childhood with unforgettable memories known to never exist.  if there was one person who understood it was 

Michael a mega superstar often seen as weird, genius a freak, child like and UN earthy creature not of this world like a a rare alien never seen but known to existed an aura like no other that can't always be comprehend.

Mike and Michael both cross paths with a mind of their own forming what seems like unlikely friendship both so different but so much alike .
coming together to destroy Sony a  music agency that acts like they're part of the government with so much power as they try to take them down.
 A secret that has to be kept as Mike and Michael realize they are time travels, stuck in a triangle of love and hate past and present, will they be able to fix what's forever broken or will things remain the same that was never meant to be changed.

description:
Book One in the War Torn series.
--

On May 16, 2010, a WWII plane wreckage is discovered in Greenland. Two days later, during the excavation and investigation, a body is found comatose, protected from the elements by the plane's body. The woman is transferred to S.H.I.E.L.D. after investigation, and nine days after her discovery, wakes up.

It is discovered that her name is Amy Lamel. Amy claims to be no one special, just someone upon whom a miracle fell. But in reality, she holds an impressive stack of accomplishments: incredible aim with most guns; well-trained in hand-to-hand combat; well-versed in engineering; a member of the Army Nurse Corps and respected medical professional; and the would-be fiance of Howard Stark, had she survived the war in the usual manner.

Now Amy has to face a world where the man she loved is dead and society has evolved, and learn how to deal with all of her experiences without giving away her true past.

One of these "rules" for living in the modern world will be broken. Whose fault it is, and how it happens? Well, that's a whole 'nother story.

description:
Seventeen year old Liv couldn't wait to see her best friend Liam Payne and finally meet his band, One Direction, for the first time. Little does she know that all five boys would fall in love with her! 
How will she ever make a decision between them! 
Liam has always been there for her and he's loved her in more ways than she could imagine. 
Louis is as hilarious as he is sweet. 
Niall is the old romantic who would sweep Liv right off her feet. 
Zayn is mysterious, loving and kind. 
Harry is sexy, seductive and daring, the bad boy. 
How would Liv choose? 
Also includes: 
-one direction songs and their inspiration 
-directioner inside jokes 
-POV from all the boys

Após uma cerimônia em memória de Allison DiLaurentis, a amiga cujo corpo foi encontrado três anos após seu desaparecimento, as garotas descobrem que todas estavam recebendo mensagens de texto e emails assinados por 'A', ameaçando revelar seus mistérios mais íntimos. Como desconfiavam que Ali poderia estar viva e ser a responsável pelos recados, elas sentem uma mistura de muita tristeza e alívio com a confirmação de sua morte. Mas 'A' continua a atormentar cada uma das meninas e, desesperadas para descobrir a verdade, elas ficam chocadas ao ver que Toby Cavanaugh, irmão de Jenna, voltou à cidade.

 Everyone knows that losing friends is a natural part of the high school experience.  Yet, what happens when a friend doesn't intentionally "go ghost" but is abruptly taken away?
         Kameron, Grayson, Mikey, Yasmin, and Jenna have been thick as thieves from childhood. Rightfully so-they make up the American minority in the German twin city of Arabella Park. When one of the five suddenly turns up missing, the remaining friends must find a way to bring her back while keeping up the facade of leading ordinary small-town lives. 
        As they search for their missing friend, they discover things about themselves and one another that will catapult them into an explosive climax and the ultimate revelation of who done it.
        A multi-faceted mystery, Arabella Park brings to life what it means to endure the most frightful, profound time of one's life-the teenage years-while being stretched to the limits of what it means to be an adult, even a hero.

description:
Trey has been changing names and faces since he became an official member of the group. And yes, Trey, is not his real name, and his face, is not his original face. But he liked this one, this particular identity. So for years, he has been Trey. Just Trey.

Besides, he wants to forget what happened to Tomoyuki, Mark, Carlos, James and his other identities. They remind him of a past he tries to erase.

But can he really forget something that shaped him for who he is right now? Can he escape a life he did not choose but was born into?

And who is he really?
Tomoyuki?
Mark?
Carlos?
James?
Trey?

Who is he trying to kid?

He is not Trey.

He is no one.

He is a man with No Name, No Face.

description:
This planet we call earth are full of billions of people that are either a like or opposites. There are dangerous people and there are good people. Sarah Jensen is a fresh graduate form college and has the heart of an angel. She always tries to look at the positive. She gets spooked easily but won't be afraid to stick up for herself. She has a back story that she hardly knows about other than how her family had struggles. 

Jason Benion was a man who is rich and selfish. He's dangerous and everyone who knows of his name knows that he is bad news. However when he wants something he gets it without hesitation. He never thought he needed love until he met Sarah. He thought she was just an ordinary girl until he learns  more about her past.

Mystery, love, confusion, fear, sadness, and so much more lies ahead for these two. Sarah will soon learn the dangers that men like this hold. But once she allows him to take her heart she will have no choice but to never go back to the old life she knew. He will be forced to never let her go. After all, he is the mafia gang leader.

**Author's Note**
WARNING: Very strict on plagiarism 
-Also I normally post within just a couple of days so don't worry once you finish a chapter, another one is coming soon
-And please don't criticize author's work. We spend hours, days, weeks, months, and sometimes years working hard on our stories. So please keep your hate to yourself

description:
Trey has been changing names and faces since he became an official member of the group. And yes, Trey, is not his real name, and his face, is not his original face. But he liked this one, this particular identity. So for years, he has been Trey. Just Trey.

Besides, he wants to forget what happened to Tomoyuki, Mark, Carlos, James and his other identities. They remind him of a past he tries to erase.

But can he really forget something that shaped him for who he is right now? Can he escape a life he did not choose but was born into?

And who is he really?
Tomoyuki?
Mark?
Carlos?
James?
Trey?

Who is he trying to kid?

He is not Trey.

He is no one.

He is a man with No Name, No Face.

description:
This planet we call earth are full of billions of people that are either a like or opposites. There are dangerous people and there are good people. Sarah Jensen is a fresh graduate form college and has the heart of an angel. She always tries to look at the positive. She gets spooked easily but won't be afraid to stick up for herself. She has a back story that she hardly knows about other than how her family had struggles. 

Jason Benion was a man who is rich and selfish. He's dangerous and everyone who knows of his name knows that he is bad news. However when he wants something he gets it without hesitation. He never thought he needed love until he met Sarah. He thought she was just an ordinary girl until he learns  more about her past.

Mystery, love, confusion, fear, sadness, and so much more lies ahead for these two. Sarah will soon learn the dangers that men like this hold. But once she allows him to take her heart she will have no choice but to never go back to the old life she knew. He will be forced to never let her go. After all, he is the mafia gang leader.

**Author's Note**
WARNING: Very strict on plagiarism 
-Also I normally post within just a couple of days so don't worry once you finish a chapter, another one is coming soon
-And please don't criticize author's work. We spend hours, days, weeks, months, and sometimes years working hard on our stories. So please keep your hate to yourself

description:
The beautiful young merhog Sonic is the son of King Jules, whose kingdom lies deep in the sea. Sonic has an obsession with the human world and all the stuff of the people, something that his father absolutely can not appreciate because he hates the people wholeheartedly. He therefore directs his court musician, the merechidna Knuckles, to look after him. One night Sonic and the merfox Tails see the young and still unmarried Prince Shadow on board of a ship. When the ship lands in a storm and decays, he saves Shadow from the waves and brings him safely to land. Sonic soon met Shadow on land. Although Shadow is charmed by Sonic, he does not recognize him as the boy who saved him. 

How will this end? Read it to find out!

There will be a chapter between 3 and 5 days!

description:
"How could even think of rejecting me? I'm gorgeous," the obviously arrogant boy said.
 
"Lucky for me, I wasn't even thinking of getting with you," I said sourly.

I winked and walked away from him, swaying my hips with every step, making half the boys at this party stop and stare. 

Passing Maya, I skipped over to the bar. I looked over at her, winked, and downed another shot of Whiskey. 

--------------------

It was a game Arden and her best friend created. 
For the whole summer, they could only get drunk off Whiskey, no getting drunk off love. 

It worked. Everything was turning out fine, until one night at a house party when everything went crazy. Shots were taken, secrets were told, things happened. 


He was her light when all she saw was darkness. When she was stuck in a horrible place, outside her friend's house, completely drunk, with nowhere to go.

She is Arden Smith.
He is Apollo Tyler.

This is their story.

WARNING!!

This story MAY include self harm! So if you don't want to get into it, I suggest you stop now, even though I might give you a warning before it happens!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Hey guys! I can't really promise that I'm a great writer...but I'll try my best :) Anyways, this book might be...complicated? I won't really have a schedule, just know that I'll post pretty frequently and the chapters will be pretty long? I'm really sorry, this is my first book, so don't expect anything to big, but like I said, I'll try my best ?

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

ANYWAYS ON WITH THE INFORMATION

You're Garroth Ro Maeve's twin sister, and the youngest out of all your three brothers, Garroth, Zane, and Vylad. Plus, you're best friends with Laurence, but you feel as if you've been growing apart, ever since you introduced him to Garroth. You all go to Phoenix Drop High, and you're only real friends are Laurence, and your brothers. You're not much of a bad girl, but not a fully goody two shoes either, plus, you're a little bit of a introvert and a little shy. Did I mention you do dance and have a pretty good talent in singing? ( At least that's what Laurence says ;) ) Also, you're a sophomore.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

DISCLAIMER

All the characters in this story belong to Jess. (Aphmau) Check her out! ( If you haven't already ;) )

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Enjoy! -Emz ✌?

Born with a father who hates her.

Blamed for things she never did.

Given magic she doesn't understand.

She's broken. She's upset.

But she's not afraid to fight back. 

Meet Skye, a young Phoenix who lives with two of her closet and best friends, Robin and Wolf. Saved from a house which was burning in a "wildfire", Robin has taken care of Skye since she was an infant. 

Now Skye is older and is in more danger than she's ever known possible. She's being hunted and blamed for terrible crimes; ones she never commited. 

This is a story of strength. This is a story of happiness and sadness in the darkest parts of Skye's life. This is a story of going beyond expectations.

This is A Skye's Limit.

A Skye's Limit is book #2 in the fantastic Fantasy/Adventure series, Phoenix Territory.

Meanwhile, a lone swordsman, seeking a peaceful life, finds himself involved in the war again as the warlords attempted to take him as their weapon.

Later, a group of martial artists and ancient wise men pursue a journey to end the war by teaching the art of Kung Fu so peace can return. But their teaching is thwarted by the war itself and they are forced to fight back.

And finally, an army of elite warriors defend the warring kingdoms from the coming threats in the West, South and North.

All of these occurring events will someday shake the very land itself.

But a question lies within the minds of the people in the 3 kingdoms: will peace return or disappear?

description:
Lyna's life didn't turn out how she hoped. She married and had a child with a man who doesn't seem to care.

When she gets a message from a past lover she is conflicted. With thoughts of him come images of the heat they shared and his unending love for her.

Did she make a mistake? Was she meant to live differently? What will become of the lonely housewife?

Is the flutter in her belly merely the reliving of memories and the happiness she knew before?

Will the butterflies be enough?

What if one girl meets a boy who hates the rules and would do anything to kill her? Jungkook was number 100 and she was also number 100. None was to share the same number. So why did these two share the same number?

                                                 
It's day one. I am ready to find number 100. I have to kill him, or else I will get killed myself. I don't care who he is, but we can't be two with the same number. I don't know how we share the same number, or why I have to hide what number I am. But this ends now, say goodbye to your loved ones number 100.
                                              JK

Read to find out, but be aware that there will be slow updates

description:
After witnessing the horrible murders of your parents at the age of 7, you haven't been the same since. You become a mute, shutting yourself out from the world, not doing much. description:
Besides having superpowers and a past that doesn't make sense, Phoenix is like any other college student...who just happens to be trying to avoid the League of Superheroes. Why is he avoiding the good guys? He doesn't know. They end up finding him, and once he's in their database, he thinks his troubles are over. But what happens when it turns out that there are dangerous things at play, and he's somehow managed to get himself involved?

Welcome to a world of superheroes and villains, of plots covering for other plots, of family who don't know they're family, and of many, many secrets.

description:
Imagine having a catchy tune stuck in your head for a whole day. You would want to take your mind off it. 

Right?

Right. 

That's what Athena wanted to do.

So she went for a walk and got lost...

Just when she thinks she found hope of returning back home she gets kidnapped. 

Athena can be stupid but this girl has got guts. She figures away to escape but being cocky is in her personality. So, she wants to brag to her kidnappers. When she does, they come looking for her. 

She didn't know that she crossed a territory that was not hers to cross.

Soon, her kidnappers kidnap her again. Only, this time it's harder to escape. She's locked in a dungeon all alone. 

She doesn't know, that she's going into unfamiliar territory (literally and figuratively). 

ONE MORE THING, SHE FINDS HER SOUL MATE! 

NO, ITS NOT NUTELLA OR OREOS OR ANY OTHER TYPE OF FOOD. HER MATE...

Read on to accompany her on her journey. Stay with her through thick and thin. It's about to be a long ride...but it's just the beginning.

"Daddy." 

Jungkook spit out his water all over the table, coughing as he tried to regain his breath. 

"Excuse me?" He asked as he looked at an innocent Taehyung, who seemed to not understand the word that just left him mouth. 

"It's what Jin calls Namjoonie."

---

Jungkook is the school bad boy and overall is dangerous. He's involved in gangs and is one of the most feared people in school. One day he does something that nearly gets him expelled but gets an offer. The offer stated that if he helped out the schools "special" class his actions would be forgotten. 

Of course he takes up that offer but what if he gets assigned to Taehyung? 

Taehyung has CDD - a disorder that causes him to act like a child. He's very dependent on other people because of this and is pretty innocent because of his overprotective brother.

As soon as they meet their lives intertwine.

What will happen to the couple?

description:
Someone once said a broken heart is still beating. 
It has to, how else are you supposed to live?
But when that will to live is gone and that heart is still broken in two,
tell me baby,
does it hurt you too? 
Sometimes i wonder if you love me the way i've always loved you. 
I know what i did was wrong and i regret it but i miss you. 
I miss everything about you. 
Those eyes, that hair, your skin and your smile. 
You're all i've ever wanted in a partner, if only i knew how to tell you

myself

Damian Rogers is the kind of guy you push past in school. Let's see he's got a stuttering issue, ugly mop hair and is as skinny as a stick. Who could ever love him? 
But then here comes possibly the prettiest boy he had ever seen. Jordan. But Jordan isn't the pretty boy he seems. He's got the looks but his underlying plan is to break whoever this stuttering bitch is. To get back at someone personally is way different than hurting who they love most. 
It's cruel and Jordan knows it, that's why he dangles Damian like an ornament on a Christmas right before the boy who loves him most, and let's him shatter on the hardwood floors. 

Love's a bitch

"It's common sense. Everyone knows about it - you'd be stupid not to. Some people hate it. Some people love it. Some people admire other's talents, yet others wish that the stupid drawings never appeared on their arms. Personally, I find it stupid. My arms - they're always bare. As if whoever is destined to be mine doesn't want to ever find their soulmate. That's why they're always bare. And I can't do anything about it."

A world in which one draws on their arm, and their soulmate has it appear on their arm. But Kim Namjoon doesn't believe in it - his arms have always been bare, other for the doodles drawn on his arm by himself out of boredom, because it seems like his soulmate will never make any attempts at trying to find him. 

Or that was what Namjoon believed.

"Dylan! I will not marry you....because now...I don't love you anymore!!" Jaz said to Dylan and leaves his office crying.

"What?" This was Dylan reaction when his soon to be wife trespassed to his office's board of director's meeting and announced her break up/ canceling upcoming wedding with him.

Will Dylan agree with her decision or does he have some other plan to make her his?

After a week:(Jaz again in Dylan's office)

"Dylan! what's this?" Neetu asks him staring at a document which she just received.


"Marriage certificate, my well-educated wifey!! and it officially proves that you are mine and I am yours" replied Dylan dryly and pulls her into his embrace, kissing her lovingly.

"What?" This was Jaz's reaction when she hears that she is already married to her arrogant Ex-Fiance.

What happens when.......
 Jaz (Dr.Jaz a -cardiologist) innocent, adorable, outspoken, confident daughter of Dr. Carl Smith and Jennifer Smith who always have a positive attitude towards life and  in love, destiny and fate falls in love with Mr. Dylan,Ceo of Cross Group of Companies one among London's top 5 Billionaires and most eligible bachelor-businessman in London, who was always praised for his appealing looks, winning attitude and discerning judgement. 

See the twists and turns, up's and down's, tragedy and love, fun and romance in Dylan and Jaz's life.....and how the billionaire is going to get her heart back?

Setelah kehilangan Khadija, Asma meninggalkan Suriah. Ke manakah kakinya melangkah? Dia mengayunkan langkah ke beberapa negeri Muslim hingga destinasi terakhirnya adalah Bumi Surga. 
Namun sepanjang perjalanannya, dia tidak terlepas dari pengintaian agen rezim yang menjadikannya target operasi. Dan menjadi lebih rumit lagi ketika dia menjadi target  operasi setiap negara yang berkepentingan di 'ibukota negeri Khilafah yang hilang' itu.
Selamat membaca.

My cold Heart

Aurora Morreti was once a sweet and innocent girl, after her husband -Sebastian Vetrov- betrayed her by sleeping around with other women throughout their marriage and lying about loving her, she became a cold-hearted person. 

When Aurora found out what her husband was doing, she left. Without leaving behind a clue of where to find her. It was like she just evaporated. 

Aurora left hurt, heart broken, and her cheating bastard of a husband's seed in her. 

Many years went by, Sebastian looked for Aurora because according to him she was the one and only thing he loved in the world. But he failed to find her. 

What will happen when Aurora comes back to town to visit her dying mother, with Sebastian's replica by her side? Will she ever forgive him? Will he ever forgive her for keeping his child from him?

Read My Cold Heart to find out what happens next.

description:
My cold Heart

Aurora Morreti was once a sweet and innocent girl, after her husband -Sebastian Vetrov- betrayed her by sleeping around with other women throughout their marriage and lying about loving her, she became a cold-hearted person. 

When Aurora found out what her husband was doing, she left. Without leaving behind a clue of where to find her. It was like she just evaporated. 

Aurora left hurt, heart broken, and her cheating bastard of a husband's seed in her. 

Many years went by, Sebastian looked for Aurora because according to him she was the one and only thing he loved in the world. But he failed to find her. 

What will happen when Aurora comes back to town to visit her dying mother, with Sebastian's replica by her side? Will she ever forgive him? Will he ever forgive her for keeping his child from him?

Read My Cold Heart to find out what happens next.

Cato Boyer es uno de los chicos más ricos del distrito dos, es guapo, misterioso, sediento de sangre, tiene un fuerte temperamento, es frío, no tiene sentimientos y es extremadamente competitivo. Pero no juzgues a un libro por su portada, no todo es lo que parece... tal vez su vida no es tan perfecta como parece.

Ya conoces a Clove y Cato, ahora puedes leer su historia.

The Chairman has taken a liking towards the girl. Understanding and polite in her own way, she decides to volunteer as a helper to escort the newcomers in the school. Though, it would be quite difficult. Her appearance does not fit in much so she have to go through a drastic change to appeal to others. [Y/N] did not notice that eyes were set upon her from somebody she did not expect. Now her emotions are put into overdrive as she experience news things with strange people.

description:
Alguna vez has sentido que alguna parte de tu conciencia se puede apoderar de ti? voces que te dicen que tomes deciciones diferentes a las que tienes pensadas y te hace dudar?. Jonathan David Good es un Wrestler profesional, trabaja en la empresa WWE bajo el ceudonimo de DEAN AMBROSE, todo anda perfecto hasta un lado de su personalidad que el creia era solo un personaje que habia dejado atras comienza a reaparecer como JON MOXLEY, pidiendole hacer a Jonathan cosas que el ya no quiere pero que sin duda, por culpa de MOXLEY desea. 

Por otro lado tenemos a Saraya Jade Bevis, que igual trabaja en WWE bajo el ceudonimo de PAIGE, ella acaba de hacer su tan esperado regreso despues de haber tenido ciertos problemas con la empresa.., al poco tiempo de haber vuelto una lesión causa su desgracia, una de no poder volver a luchar en WWE. ella conoce a Dean que esta dispuesto a ayudarla, pero tambien conoce a Moxley que esta dispuesto a hacerle daño.

PAIGE vs MOXLEY?, podra ella ganarle a esa bestia? 7u7. podra Jonathan dejarse llevar por Saraya? o al contrario, dejarse consumir por JON MOXLEY?. 
Lucha, Gore, Celos y venganza, y aún mas que eso habra en esta historia.

description:
When Julia David's moves to the sleepy town of Willow Creek, all she wants to do is forget about her brothers grewsome murder, with only a year between then and now. Chorophobia, from the Greek word choro meaning "to dance," is an irrational fear of dancing or anything resembling dancing, even of watching others do it.

This is not a very good fear to have when everyone you know is a dancer.

This is not a very good fear to have when the only way to survive... is to dance.

description:
She'll be okay.
At lease that's what she tells herself. 


Growing up I always told myself; head up, stand tall, and smile through the pain. That's what got me through most of my life. 

It has always been my mom, my sister and I. But technically it was only me, myself, and I. Mother always working, Sister moved out, and I living in the land of the forgotten. 

Being that I had daddy issues since birth, that meant he was always out the picture. But to me it only meant one more person out the picture. 

Love isn't real it's just the excuse people use to have sex. But when "love" create another human being must people tend to get scared and run like the wind. 

But what happens when Cupid tried to pull that love game on the one person who doesn't believe in love. 


I am Veronica Queens and this is my story...........

They find many ways to terrorize the Clans...stealing their kits, killing their warriors, giving their warriors slow deaths, killing their leader and deputy, and even killing their medicine cats. Pretty soon, there's a big war between all the Clans. But who will win? If BloodClan wins, the Clans will be lost forever.... (takes place between The Last Hope and Bramblestar's Storm)

description:
When I saw her for the first time, a strange feeling came over me, at first I couldn't quite place it. Now I know it was a mixture of surprise and anticipation. 
I didn't made much out of it at first, but I still couldn't get her off my head. How often does one finds a girl walking alone on a deserted road, wearing a black tight dress, high hells and dragging a dusty jacket. 
I couldn't see much of her face, but the only glimpse I had was enough to make my stomach tightened. 
She didn't looked lost, or helpless, instead it looked like she knew exactly where she was going, it looked like she was on her way towards something.

description:
This newer version of Royal Pain has a few mature scenes and more added detail. I hope if you're a rereader of the book you get sucked in all over again. 

*Synopsis*
Three identical vampire princes are searching for a human girl to one day rule their kingdom. Little did they know that Deva was not like the rest of the girls. She does everything to sabotage her chances but it isn't enough to shield her heart. Eventually the twisting and pulling force her guard down and she falls; she falls so deeply it hurts. Her vulnerability will lead her down a dark winding path she was never ready for. Vampires, a kingdom, a crown, love were just the tip of her iceberg. 

I promise this is a book that will not disappoint.

When I saw her for the first time, a strange feeling came over me, at first I couldn't quite place it. Now I know it was a mixture of surprise and anticipation. 
I didn't made much out of it at first, but I still couldn't get her off my head. How often does one finds a girl walking alone on a deserted road, wearing a black tight dress, high hells and dragging a dusty jacket. 
I couldn't see much of her face, but the only glimpse I had was enough to make my stomach tightened. 
She didn't looked lost, or helpless, instead it looked like she knew exactly where she was going, it looked like she was on her way towards something.

description:
This newer version of Royal Pain has a few mature scenes and more added detail. I hope if you're a rereader of the book you get sucked in all over again. 

*Synopsis*
Three identical vampire princes are searching for a human girl to one day rule their kingdom. Little did they know that Deva was not like the rest of the girls. She does everything to sabotage her chances but it isn't enough to shield her heart. Eventually the twisting and pulling force her guard down and she falls; she falls so deeply it hurts. Her vulnerability will lead her down a dark winding path she was never ready for. Vampires, a kingdom, a crown, love were just the tip of her iceberg. 

I promise this is a book that will not disappoint.

description:
The devil is alluring, addictive - he lures one in gently, enticing them with honeyed words and false promises. Why, he captivated a third of his fellow angels, bewitching them with his diabolical charm. However, many of those who have fallen victim to his enamoring temptations are not truly at fault. For Lucifer lurks in the dark, plotting behind a mask of shadows and a faultless exterior. That he might be merely playing the role of friend was a thought one would deem inconceivable.

But the devil is not alone in his hiding, for you, too, disguised your true self. You acted out the happy grandchild; the grade A, model student. You preformed as the brave, happy go lucky friend - someone people knew they could always count on to be there for them, through thick and thin. All those things, the people around you expected you to be, and so you played the parts with nimble, refined grace, dolefully accepting the labels and positions you'd been assigned.

Your every action- every word, every step- you would calculate perfectly beforehand, petrified by the possibility of being caught and exposed for what you truly are: a downcast, forlorn soul, with no more spirit than a mindless marionette.

But man can not compare to the devil's skill in show - you can't defeat the puppeteers at their own game. It is far too twisted and mystifying of a dance for you to keep up your flawless facade.

I bid you good luck, human. You'll need it, in this dark, malevolent masquerade.

description: My mom used to tell me that lighthouses were like beacons of hope. We would travel every summer up the east coast to Maine and stop at all the lighthouses we could find. My mom went missing with my dad at the start of my senior year and since then things have gone down hill. I have to find them but I have no idea where to start. It's the summer after my senior year and while I have plans for the future, I still feel lost and without purpose. I guess you could say I need my own lighthouse right about now. Come fall, I'll be a freshman at Brown but until then I have the summer to figure out who I am and how my life got to where it is.  But with a new mysterious guy, and two amazing best friends who've planned a summer full of adventure, maybe my chances aren't all that bad.

description:
What would you do if the very person you wanted to destroy, starts to win over you heart?
___

You know Quinn Demitrius, everyone does. Perhaps you've seen her on the covers of Vogue, on the TV wining a Grammy or even shopping on fifth Avenue with her beloved sisters. She's Hollywood's hottest starlet, and the things she did to become the name on everyone's lips are merely stains on the pavement beneath her Prada heels.

Sebastian Bishop, the mysterious actor with an even more confusing past. Sebastian has a hitlist, but not the murder kind. Instead he has a list of people who he's hell bent on destroying with Quinn's Demitrius name written in red underline. 

With the rest if Hollywood's golden brat pack, an entire fake relationship, a mysterious blogger exposing Hollywood's elites dirty laundry, drama, scandals,cute moments and a sinful amount of bittersweet kisses.

Bittersweet Kisses is a story bound to tug on your heartstrings.
___

«His Kisses were like lemon slices dipped in honey, bitter, sweet and strangely irrisitable»

description: This book is a guide on ways to cheese bosses in the "Dark Souls" games. "Cheesing" means to defeat a boss with as little effort as possible, without the cheese being harder than the actual fight. For example, standing in an arena and doing nothing as you watch the boss fall off a ledge and die, due to your character's position. This guide should be getting updated a lot, and if anyone has advice on cheese strats it would greatly appreciated that you share in the comments. description:
Brooklyn Kelly or Brooke for short is a part of the Talkeetna Shifter Clan in Alaska because she is a shifter. She can shift into a Snow Leopard that is rather feral in character meaning the Brooklyn has little to no control over whatever her Leopard does meaning that not many people would see her as a good mate. As such Brooklyn has pretty much given up on ever finding her true mate because she wouldn’t be able to accept him as her mate because of her Snow Leopard. What really annoys her though is that the way her Snow Leopard is now wasn’t caused by her genetics it was caused by her rubbish upbringing along with her two sibling’s upbringing. 
When Loki the God of Mischief is quite literally dumped onto the clan’s doorstep Brooklyn begins to feel things that she wouldn’t have even thought she could feel and the same goes for her Snow Leopard. Well at first Brooklyn ignores Loki pretty much and argues with him to no end but as time goes on and they begin to become friends Brooklyn soon realises that her feelings for Loki are set deep within herself.
But when S.H.I.E.L.D finds out that Loki is in Alaska and has been accepted into the clan all hell basically breaks loose with Nick Fury sending the Avengers to retrieve Loki. But when Brooklyn also gets caught up in the cross fire and is taken back to S.H.I.E.L.D her Leopard turns rouge and Brooklyn looses all control and she can’t even shift back. Nick Fury eventually agrees to let Loki in with the already rouge Snow Leopard only to see if she can be calmed down.
What will happen to Brooklyn? Will she calm down? Will Loki be allowed to remain a part of the clan?
Warning: Contains a very expressive woman who swears like a sailor. A sarcastic God of Mischief. A very aggressive Snow Leopard and some scenes of the sexual nature.

description:
Penny está harta de lo chicos y harta de salir con ellos, de modo que hace un juramento: "Nunca más". ha sufrido demasiadas malas experiencias y le han hecho daño demasiados chicos . Pero no le va a volver a pasar , ya que decide formar el Club de los Corazones Solitarios y no citarse con chicos nunca más.
 Penny no es la única  que están cansada de la forma en la que las chicas cambian (casi siempre para peor) al tratar de conseguir al chico de sus sueños... Poco a poco sus amigas y todas las chicas del instituto se van sumando al Club de los Corazones Solitarios. Sin que Penny lo espere, el Club se convierte en una autentica revolución y ella en la chica más popular del instituto por renunciar a las citas amorosas , lo que resulta ser una lástima, ya que ha encontrado a cierto chico que, a su pesar, le gusta...
el único chico por el que merecería la pena darle otra oportunidad al amor.

description:
427 years After Doom (A.D.) the stars continue to protect themselves from the species of every planet in the solar system. Their strategies and technology changed over time, making themselves stronger to have a long life expectancy. Every star is important to defend their Mother Sun and to prolong its life or else, the Great Doom will happen.

Meanwhile, two stars, Altair from Aquila and Chara from Canes Venatici, write paperstars to their own starmates-- a forbidden belief in their kind. Anyone who will be caught doing this will be cursed to become a slave until the end of their life. 

But Altair and Chara believe in paperstars and when they fill their star jars, they will meet their starmates and will be collided with them forever.

But what if they get caught? What if the paperstars is just a myth?

"What are you?" She asked.

"I'm not human." He replied.

"If you're are not human, then tell me what you are." She demanded.

He shook his head and smiled creepily, "You should find out yourself."

-----

Park Jimin, a mysterious supernatural being falls in love with Jung Lily, a normal high school girl, he refuses to reveal himself, so she sets herself on a mission to find out his true identity, but when she did, her life changes forever.

-----

"When are you going to reveal yourself?" She asked.

"When the time comes." He replied behind the shadows.

-----

"U-ummm Chimine, i-is that b-blood on your h-hands?"

"No?"

"Dude!! I'm serious!!"

"Didn't I tell you to stop calling me dude."

-----

description:
SEQUEL TO UNITED

"This is not a civil war." 

"Then what is it?"

"The end of the Avengers Initiative." 
***
It's been almost two years since the Revengers first landed their ship on Midgard. New recruits have joined the Avengers, while Asgard thrives in secrecy, shrouded from the rest of the Earth. Overall, it's been an eventful,  but memorable two years. Everyone is finally happy.

That is, until two brothers discover the Eye of Agamotto, and a way to bring Frigga back to life. Traveling in time, of course, has its undesirable effects, and Thor and Loki soon find themselves trapped on Asgard while the Avengers are nothing more than broken memories of the past. 

One thing is for certain. Even if they are able to restore their original timeline, they must live with the knowledge that one thing is for certain.

Nothing will ever be the same again.

K A I R O S 

( n. ) the perfect, delicate, crucial moment; 
the fleeting rightness of time and place that creates the opportune atmosphere for
action, words, or movement; also, weather.

~

" Love is never late. She knows what she's doing ", She spoke with light and airy tone. Almost like she knew I could hear her. Almost like she knew of  the sudden change in my heart.

With that final sentence, she left. Leaving me at the mercy of the words in my head.

#49 | H

•-•-•

❝You know, most girls directly tell me if they like me. You stumble into a door, trip over air, and then end up somehow kissing me.❞

•-•-•

Blaire Collins has a curse.

A curse that goes by the name of clumsiness.

Despite being confident and bold, she tumbles over anything and everything; whether it's furniture or air, Blaire is almost positive that no one can beat her when it comes to her eternal embarrassment of being a klutz. 

So, when her so-called 'curse' causes her to trip onto River Knight, the academy's richest student, and end up locking lips with him, Blaire is absolutely mortified and is sure that the rest of her life will end up with her digging herself into a hole and never coming out. 

After all, a boy like him is sure to take every chance he can get to embarrass her over the incident, right?

Wrong.

Instead of doing what most people would do, River decides to befriend the clumsy yet confident girl.

"The depth of the unsaid,
 is often deeper than any word that could be spoken.
And the thoughts that are only in our heads,
 are often darker than anything that could be put in the open."

You? What's your current situation? Isa ka ba sa mga taong nasa stage nang falling in love, o isa dun sa mga taong na fall out of love na?

"We're Not Normal"
∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆
"I can't do this anymore", I hardly said, trying to breathe property. His face was barely an inch away from mine. 

"Why addy? Why cant you?", Zed said trying hard not to break down into tears. 

"Zed you know why we can't be together, we're from two different worlds. I stuttered trying my hardest not to walk away once again. 

"Addy, I love you and I want to be......, Addy wait..please" that was last thing I heard from zed. How could he love me when he hurts me all the time, how could he love me when I don't even know what love is. I'm barely holding on to whatever I have left and I'm this close of falling apart. I need to get out of here, I need to leave for awhile until I okay again. 

"Addy, I love you" -zed
"You can't love someone when you keep breaking them" -Addison

A girl and A zombie
∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆∆

When 16 year old Addison is finally able to get her life back on track and finally be able to put her past with zed behind her, so she can come back to Seabrook and try out for the cheer squad. Her cousin Bucky is keeping a eye on her and to remind u he's the cheer captain, and Addison made a new a friend who can help her get over her past and have someone to talk to. 

But what happens when zombies are allowed to attend Seabrook high school, with the humans. What happens when zed sees Addison for the first time in 6 years. What happens when old memories are coming back up. 
Will they be able to be together and realize they still love each other or will their different worlds come between them again. 
What happens if they get in fights and arguments like before but this time will it be different. Will Addison finally tell Zed she loves him.

description:
Malia Tate returns back to her old town after two years. She was no longer the cute chubby girl with bright pink braces and large black rimmed glasses. She's back and better than ever.

She coincidentally crosses paths her former best friend Archer Silva who ditched her for popularity - he too has gone through a change.

He was no longer the rather chubby boy with a round face and coconut hairstyle. His appearance changed massively, his hair was now styled into a quiff, enhancing the colour of his tousled brown hair. His facial structures were more defined.

Malia has plans for Archer and the rest of her former high-school classmates, she wanted them to realise how it felt to be left out.

-

The guy pushed me against the brick wall and smirked as he looked me up and down. 
"That was a mean thing to say little one.. but I shall say your sassiness is a turn on " He chuckles. 

"Let go of me you freak before I do something that I'm not gonna regret!" I struggle against his hold. 

"Aw how cute" he pinches my cheek. Bringing my knee up I hit his crotch. From the pain he let's go and cups his jewels. "Son.. of a bitch!" He growls out. 

I kick his ass making him hit head first into the brick wall knocking him out. Seeing someone else running towards me, I run the opposite way but instead I'm lifted off the ground and against someone's chest. "Where do you think your going little one?"

She has only a few friends and is bullied a lot in school. Donatella also has a secret but she is not allowed to tell anyone. 

One day she goes out with her friend Lilac. Then she finds some mysterious jewels called The Jewels of Mother V.I. 

She was told that mother V.I. hid her jewels so it didn't fall into the wrong hands. Donatella bought it and wore it to school the next day.

During her lunch time she finds 18 year old Jake Roberts being troubled by Marcy. 

She saves him from getting in trouble. At the library he finds out that Donatella has a secret that is hurting her.

Then Donatella gets a warning that someone is after her and the jewels and that she needs to return to Mother V.I. Jake goes with her and the both start to fall deep in love with each other.

What will happen when Jake learns Donatella's secret? What challenges will they face? Will they make it to Mother V.I.? 
                   
All these Questions will be answered when you read this story. The Legend of Mother V.I.

description:
Je m'appelle Balkis Lawd. J'ai vingt-quatre ans.

J'aime... un peu raconter ma vie. Beaucoup la confrontation. Passionnément  mon travail en tant qu'agent secret. À la folie la vie que j'ai eu avec l'amour de ma vie. Le problème c'est que... je n'aime pas du tout l'amour. 

Je suis sûrement brisée, sûrement joyeuse. Mais par-dessus tout, n'essaye pas de me manquer de respect.

Contrairement à ce que tu peux penser, mon histoire n'est pas à l'eau de rose. J'ai déjà vécu ainsi mais ce temps est révolu. Maintenant l'eau est devenue plus rouge.

***

« - Je t'en supplie tu dois me croire quand je dis que ce n'é...

- Stop. J'en ai assez entendu. J'aurais jamais cru qu'attendre un homme était pire qu'attendre une peine de mort. Au moins un prisonnier sait à quoi il va faire face. Toi ce n'est qu'un putain de poignard dans le dos que tu as pris soin d'enfoncer dans le cœur que je t'avais donné. »

***

Salut :) Contenu pour adulte j'pense hein. C'est un roman d'amour juste un peu spécial peut-être. Et faut pas être trop trop sensible parce que je me suis dégoûtée moi-même des fois héhé..

Ambos tienen lo que cualquiera podría desear, viven su vida de recién casados en una enorme hacienda en el campo.

Pero últimamente las cosas no van tan bien en el paraíso, las discusiones se han vuelto mas constantes que el amanecer. Los sueños, el amor y la distancia, tendrán que recuperarse de una manera, comenzando de nuevo y no por elección propia. Un misterioso accidente de carro hará que esta pareja cambie su forma de ver la vida y volverse mas fuertes para enfrentar al enemigo del que nadie sospecha.

I am in my first year of high school I'm almost 15 I hate mostly everything except the coulor black sleep and twenty one pilots.
read my story it will help guide you to not be like me I'm not a smart girl now that I look at it I'm dumb and ice cold not like other girls who are sparkly I'll tell you one thing I'm telling this that's this story in my world was 5 years ago. so I'm telling this 5 years in the future I'm better I guess but I'm not heald I'm still broken like glass.so read this all I ask the first chapter some of you will leave some will stay the last people at the end of my journey will understand and won't make life mistakes they'll be sparkly. one more thing.
your ganna cry. alot.

"What?" She holds a stern look the entire time.

"Nothing, I just didn't expect you to be..." I trail off.

"You thought I was the secretary? Or even the personal assistant?" She raises an eyebrow. 

"No! Of course not," I swallow hard.

"Good," she walks from behind her desk to me. "Because now that we're business partners, you're dealing with me."

I chuckle at her attempt to intimidate me. "Oh yeah? And what makes you any different than every other person that I've dealt with?"

"Only difference, is that I'm not so easy to convince," she sends me a smirk.

-

Amelia has always been the independent and strong minded girl that everybody has picked her out to be. Owning your own firm can do that to a person and she knew what she was getting herself into. However, losing her fiance was not part of the plan. Now Amelia is running a firm all on her own. That is until she's dragged to a formal, or ball as they like to call it, by one of her closets friends and his cousin to loosen up a bit.

Theo has never had to work for anything in his life. Being born as the heir of a multi-million company has made that possible. Also with the help of being devilish handsome, brilliant, a billionaire, and having a body that anybody would love to worship. Except, rumor has it that he's a vile, tyrant, and heartless boss. Expects nothing but perfection, and if you fail, you're fired by the snaps of his fingers. Fear is the only thing his colleagues feel about him, and god forbid if anybody disrespected Theo. However, for someone who expects perfection he certainly didn't intend to find the imperfect Amelia Ponce.

While both are exceedingly successful at what they do, they both seem to be at a lost when it comes to love. In fact, not one of them believes in it, that is until they meet each other at the "ball." But there's a catch, neither of them know each other's name. 

Most people say their love is like Cinderella but trust when they say that they are anything but a fairy tale.

"What?" She holds a stern look the entire time.

"Nothing, I just didn't expect you to be..." I trail off.

"You thought I was the secretary? Or even the personal assistant?" She raises an eyebrow. 

"No! Of course not," I swallow hard.

"Good," she walks from behind her desk to me. "Because now that we're business partners, you're dealing with me."

I chuckle at her attempt to intimidate me. "Oh yeah? And what makes you any different than every other person that I've dealt with?"

"Only difference, is that I'm not so easy to convince," she sends me a smirk.

-

Amelia has always been the independent and strong minded girl that everybody has picked her out to be. Owning your own firm can do that to a person and she knew what she was getting herself into. However, losing her fiance was not part of the plan. Now Amelia is running a firm all on her own. That is until she's dragged to a formal, or ball as they like to call it, by one of her closets friends and his cousin to loosen up a bit.

Theo has never had to work for anything in his life. Being born as the heir of a multi-million company has made that possible. Also with the help of being devilish handsome, brilliant, a billionaire, and having a body that anybody would love to worship. Except, rumor has it that he's a vile, tyrant, and heartless boss. Expects nothing but perfection, and if you fail, you're fired by the snaps of his fingers. Fear is the only thing his colleagues feel about him, and god forbid if anybody disrespected Theo. However, for someone who expects perfection he certainly didn't intend to find the imperfect Amelia Ponce.

While both are exceedingly successful at what they do, they both seem to be at a lost when it comes to love. In fact, not one of them believes in it, that is until they meet each other at the "ball." But there's a catch, neither of them know each other's name. 

Most people say their love is like Cinderella but trust when they say that they are anything but a fairy tale.

I just moved to a small town called "Orphic", where people believe in alot of legends and myths.. Yeah I know that sounds crazy, but I'm stuck here. My name is Alexandra Lace Barrington, but please just call me Alex. I hate my long name. I am sixteen, and I live with my mom. My dad hasn't been in the picture for five years. Don't ask. 
   So there's this "legend" that there's a taxi that comes to you, and instead of taking you where you want to go it takes you where you need to go. Your "Destiny" kind of. There's a different driver each time. I, of course, didn't believe this; until one night I stepped into that taxi...

description:
Mr. and Mrs. Dursley, of number four, Privet Drive, were proud to say that they were perfectly normal, thank you very much. They were the last people you'd expect to be involved in anything strange or mysterious, because they just didn't hold with such nonsense.

Jasper knew that, so when he came down to breakfast the morning of his birthday and saw a strange looking letter being shoved through the mail slot, he hid it. He hid the next one that came, and the next one, until he had run out of spaces to put them. He didn't read them, he could never bring himself to, so they sat untouched from the moment they were crammed behind his wardrobe. 

When the giant man comes for his cousin, Jasper hesitantly reads his own letter, and before he knows it he is whisked off into a world with people on broomsticks and talking portraits, leaving his family behind. He thinks it's amazing, but maybe the safety of his family would have been a good thing to have as things take a turn for the worse.

description:
Quando Francesco Romannelli conheceu Erin Foyle, casaram-se em poucos dias... Mas em apenas um mês decidiram se separar.
Acreditando que o marido lhe era infiel, nada mais que um traidor, Erin decidiu pedir o divórcio. 
Mas, embora não quisesse mais ser a esposa de Francesco, ela nunca poderia se livrar dele, pois espera um filho seu.
Ao descobrir que Erin está grávida, Francesco não acredita que ela tivera a audácia de esconder dele.
Por isso, ele usará todos os meios para que o divórcio jamais aconteça.
Sua missão agora é exigi-la... Como esposa e em sua cama....

Kim Lawrence
